'''Ground Marshal''' was a military rank used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Haras Jundop]] held this rank.<ref name="RoE:TRSH">''[[Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook]]''</ref>
